10 simple things you can do today to help your weight loss journey🤞🏾

1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Give yourself grace! 💗 #gymtok #weightlosstips #glowuptips #motivation

Some hunger during weight loss is normal, but we shouldn’t act like it’s a necessary pre-requisite (or even a badge of honour).  Weight loss shouldn’t be able ravenous hunger 24/7. The focus should be on building Hunger Crushing Combos that help you maintain a calorie deficit while staying full. I have a full chapter on this in my book if you want more guidance. Stop fucking “researching” instead of “doing”. If you’ve saved every beginner workout, looked up a hundred high-protein meals, and still feel like you need one more weight loss tip before you can move, babe, you already have enough to make one decision today. You don’t need a perfect gym routine or a complete meal plan to build healthier habits. Pick a dinner that’ll actually fill you up. Learn one exercise. Take the walk. You can adjust as you go, but you cannot think your way into a stronger body.
